name: Daily AI News Digest to Telegram

parameters.content:
Daily AI News Digest to Telegram

Runs every morning, reads a small set of AI/tech RSS feeds, normalizes and deduplicates stories, ranks the top 5, asks an LLM to produce a concise digest, and sends one Telegram message. If no strong stories are found, it sends a fallback update instead.

assignments.name: digest_prompt
assignments.value:
=Create a compact daily AI news digest for Telegram for {{$json.run_date}}.

You will receive up to 5 already-ranked stories in JSON. Use only these stories.

Requirements:
- Return valid JSON only.
- Keep the intro to one line.
- For each story, write a short summary of at most 2 sentences.
- Add one concise why_it_matters line.
- Preserve the original title, source, and link exactly as provided.
- Keep the response mobile-friendly and concise.

Return this exact JSON shape:
{
  "intro": "",
  "stories": [
    {
      "title": "",
      "source": "",
      "summary": "",
      "why_it_matters": "",
      "link": ""
    }
  ]
}

Stories JSON:
{{$json.stories.toJsonString()}}

nodes.name: Parse AI Digest and Format Telegram

assignments.name: telegram_message
assignments.value: =AI News Digest | {{$json.run_date}}\nNo strong AI updates were found today across the configured feeds.
